symptom: DESCRIBE MICROFLOW of a flow with a multi-line note linked to another note emitted a `-- WARNING` comment quoting the text verbatim; the line break ended the comment mid-quote, so check failed on mxcli's own output and create or modify was refused (MDL-V1-REBUILD: the stored flow's description does not parse).
cause: prependFreeAnnotationLines put mdlQuote(caption) into a `--` comment; mdlQuote keeps line breaks, which a string literal may hold but a line comment cannot.
fix: commentLine folds \r\n, \n and \r of the quoted text into a visible ⏎ inside the comment; the @annotation literal keeps the real text.
insight: Any user text interpolated into a `--` comment must be folded to one line: a broken comment is not cosmetic, since the splice parses the stored flow's description to compare against it, so a describe defect blocks writes. cmd_navigation.go already had singleLine for the same class (offline constraints).
